title: Report linter: the worker checks its report before finishing, and collect pushes an invalid report back to the same session
description: Operator, 2026-09-28. One checker, the same parser collect uses, validates everything a role's prompt asks for: a final STATUS line with a valid word; a findings block that parses and validates (field-level errors); REVIEW-VERDICT for review jobs; close-out evidence per done item; whatever the role's output schema declares. (1) Every worker prompt tells the worker to run it (ticfac-exec-subprocess lint-report <path>, also in the cloud image) and fix what it reports before stopping. (2) At collect, a report that fails lint is pushed back to the SAME session with the lint errors (reusing the #78/#81 re-prompt path; herdr: typed into the pane), at most twice, before the attempt fails. Removes finding_invalid holds, most malformed-report missing-results, and the review no-verdict refusal. Includes findings format v2 (see description of the companion change in the PR).
acceptance_criteria: A report with an unreadable findings block is pushed back with the parse error and accepted on the corrected second answer; a lint-clean report is always accepted by collect (property test over generated reports); the prompt instructs the lint step; the linter is present in the sandbox image
